slides.texte_overlay:
6 signs you care too much
about what people think

1. You rehearse simple
phone calls in your head

2. You order what others order
so you don't stand out

3. You check who viewed
your story before anything else

4. You stay quiet in meetings
even when you know the answer

5. You hide what you're curious
about because it seems "weird"
slides.texte_sophia:
5. You hide what you're curious
about. I learn mine openly
on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
6. You explain your decisions
to people who didn't ask
